title: v0.99.89 — GSD Pure Domain Decomposition
description: Frozen from v0.99.87 W4. Isolate GSD planning/state logic as an explicit pure domain core. Findings MA-06/MA-07 intermediate. Broad gates after W2 and W4.

waves.title: v0.99.89 W0 — Golden Workflow Traces
waves.body:
## Goal
Pin plan/go/success/failure/interruption/retry/replan/resume/close semantics, records, projections, and event order.

## Gate
GSD workflow + Fast + review.

## Acceptance
Deterministic semantic trace matrix is complete.

waves.title: v0.99.89 W1 — Pure Transition Kernel
waves.body:
## Goal
Extract pure transitions, preconditions, and terminal states behind the existing facade.

## Gate
Pure-kernel + Arch + Fast + review.

## Acceptance
Kernel has no filesystem, GitHub, Runtime, or event-bus imports.

waves.title: v0.99.89 W2 — Plan/State Projection Kernel
waves.body:
## Goal
Compute PLAN/STATE/VALIDATION/Wave changes purely and apply through an atomic effect shell.

## Gate
GSD governance/workflow + Broad + crash probe + review.

## Acceptance
Projections remain equivalent and a crash cannot leave stale partial tracking.

waves.title: v0.99.89 W3 — Command Parsing and Intent Boundary
waves.body:
## Goal
Keep parser I/O-free; separate command intent from executor; preserve /go N assertion semantics.

## Gate
Parser fitness + command corpus + Fast + review.

## Acceptance
Malformed and valid commands preserve facade behavior with no skip semantics.

waves.title: v0.99.89 W4 — GSD facade thinning and release
waves.body:
## Goal
Reduce GSD facades to composition/re-export without public API breakage; publish v0.99.89.

## Gate
Broad + Arch + Workflow + Smoke + Release + independent review.

## Acceptance
Pure domains have no I/O imports and Golden Traces remain equivalent.
